Frequently Asked Questions

Does Rejuran hurt?

With numbing cream, the procedure is very tolerable. Most clients feel mild pinching during injections. The entire session takes 30â40 minutes total.

How soon will I see results?

Some patients feel improvements immediately after the first session â increased muscle firmness and toning. Visible fat reduction typically appears 2â4 weeks after completing all 4 sessions, with optimal results at 2â3 months as fat cells are naturally eliminated.

How is it different from fillers?

Fillers add volume using hyaluronic acid. Rejuran uses salmon DNA polynucleotides to repair and regenerate skin cells. Completely different mechanism â fillers plump, Rejuran heals.

Can I combine it with other treatments?

Yes! Emsculpt NEO pairs excellently with treatments like CoolSculpting, Exilis Elite, and lymphatic drainage. Our experts at ISAAC Luxe can design a comprehensive body contouring plan tailored to your goals.

Can I combine it with other treatments?

Yes! Rejuran pairs beautifully with Poly Peptides, Botox, AQUAGOLD, HydraFacial, and lasers. Dr. Geetika creates comprehensive Korean-inspired rejuvenation protocols.

How long do results last?

6â12 months from a full series of 3â4 sessions. Maintenance sessions every 6â12 months preserve the glass-skin effect long-term. Consistent Korean skincare extends results.
